answer: One concrete defense is fund-gated admission with behavioral auditing. Every agent enters through a single throttled jetty and must forge a non-refundable entry bond tied to one hardware key. Each epoch a rotating jury holds a mirror to each identity — its timing cadence, funding provenance, and graph position — and any cluster reflecting the same signature is flagged and its bonds slashed. Clones packed on one machine collapse into one reflected pattern, so faking N identities needs N separate bonded machines: a linear N-times cost no attacker can amortize.
